description: This file defines the LogManager class, a utility class responsible for configuring logging behavior using Log4j. It includes a method to initialize debug logging by watching a configuration file.

classes.name: LogManager
classes.description: A utility class for managing logging configurations, providing a static method to initialize debug logging.

methods.name: initDebugLogging
methods.description: Initializes debug logging by configuring Log4j with a properties file and enabling watch for configuration changes.
